# Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament
> The premier annual invitational cricket championship of Vindhya Pradesh, sanctioned by the Rewa Division Cricket Association (RDCA) and affiliated with the Madhya Pradesh Cricket Association (MPCA).

## Primary Documentation
- [Tournament Home](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/): Championship summary, 3–3 titles deadlock, telemetry, and 2026 champions.
- [Tournament Leaderboards & Records](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/stats/): Official consolidated player statistics combining Destroyers CC and Dread Eleven across 34 matches.
- [The Derby Teams (2)](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/teams/): The two participating marquee clubs: Destroyers CC and Dread Eleven.
- [Match Archive (34 Matches)](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/matches/): Complete 34-match fixture history with direct scorecard links to the official RDCA archive.
- [Official Regulations (14 Codes)](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/rules/): Statutory tournament regulations including Anti-Corruption, Anti-Doping, and Playing Conditions.
- [Governing Council](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/governing-council/): Executive leadership, technical committee, and match officials.
- [News & Media Releases](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/news/): Official circulars, bulletins, and tournament announcements.
- [Contact & Venues](https://abv-rewacricket.pages.dev/contact/): Divisional Cricket Stadium Neem Chauraha Rewa, MPCA and RDCA official contacts.

## Official Network
- [Destroyers Cricket Club](https://destroyers-rewacricket.pages.dev)
- [Dread Eleven](https://dread-eleven-rewacricket.pages.dev)
